shots.focal_element: Large curved virtual YouTube VR window floating in a sunlit living room, viewed over the shoulder of a seated headset wearer
shots.typography: Small centered window-title label in a clean sans-serif, regular weight, title case, default tracking; part of the composited OS UI rather than a designed caption
shots.what_happens: Over-the-shoulder live-action shot: a person on a sofa wearing the headset watches a creator video in a giant curved mixed-reality window composited into the room, with a taskbar dock below; the creator in the video gestures while the camera holds nearly still. Lyrics 'it's like riding a bike' (w19-w22) play over it.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a curved, slightly perspective-warped video panel with a thin dark title bar and a floating icon dock into tracked over-the-shoulder room footage, holding a near-static frame for about 1.6 s.

shots.focal_element: Headset wearer aiming a CG proton-pack style blaster while small marshmallow-ghost characters float around the room
shots.what_happens: Very short (about 0.5 s) mixed-reality gameplay beat: a man in a denim shirt holds controllers fused with a CG blaster as white ghost creatures drift through his bedroom; a large out-of-focus creature fills the left foreground.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut a 0.5 s medium shot of a player with CG creatures composited at several depths, placing one heavily defocused creature in the foreground to sell depth.

shots.focal_element: Same player facing camera, swinging the controllers as ghost creatures fly past with motion blur
shots.what_happens: About 0.5 s frontal wide shot of the same bedroom: the player turns toward camera mid-action while motion-blurred CG ghosts streak through foreground and background. The cut lands near detected SFX x002 (13.4186 s, unsure/impact) and the 'Bump' lyric (w24).
shots.build_rebuild: Follow s008 with a hard cut to a frontal wide angle of the same action, adding directional motion blur to fast-moving CG characters crossing the lens.

shots.focal_element: First-person view of a CG blaster held in a gloved virtual hand, centered, aimed down an apartment full of floating ghosts
shots.what_happens: Point-of-view mixed-reality gameplay: the viewer holds a virtual blaster centered in frame while dozens of ghost creatures swarm the real kitchen and living room; one creature swoops close past the left side and the free hand swings in from the right. A swoosh_reverse SFX (x003, 13.9951 s) sits just after the cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a first-person CG weapon locked to lower centre over wide-lens room footage, spawning ghosts at varied depths with one fly-by close to camera within about 1.1 s.

shots.focal_element: Young woman in a headset placing a LEGO minifigure onto a mixed-reality brick treehouse
shots.what_happens: Shallow-depth-of-field medium close-up: the woman smiles while moving a virtual minifigure onto a LEGO-style treehouse, with defocused leaves framing the foreground and bokeh lights behind. The final sheet frame (17.000 s) already shows the next scene (two people dancing with light trails and a tiny disclaimer line), so the cut probably sits slightly earlier than detected; that frame is not counted as this shot's text. Lyrics w25-w33 play over it.
shots.build_rebuild: Shoot a warm, shallow-focus medium close-up with foreground foliage bokeh and composite a CG LEGO figure tracked to the controller hand for about 2 s.
